source_records.statement: The workspace owner states that every production asset in the Core Biology pack was produced in this Figure Studio/Codex workspace.
The workspace owner explicitly selected CC0 for maximum-frictionless reuse of the Core Biology production asset pack.

An independent reviewer accepted the 26 exact current SVG identities for biological legibility, self-contained vector structure, and continuity with the existing owner-attested workspace-output scope. This engineering review does not establish legal ownership, non-infringement, or authority to make the CC0 dedication.
Five original Figure Studio/Codex model-organism vectors were reviewed and promoted into the owner-selected CC0 production pack.

source_records.note: As between the user and OpenAI, and to the extent permitted by applicable law, the user owns Output and OpenAI assigns its interest, if any, in Output.
For business/API use, as between the customer and OpenAI and to the extent permitted by applicable law, the customer owns Output and OpenAI assigns its interest, if any, in Output.

source_records.statement: Three existing nucleic-acid schematics were redrawn as original editable vectors in the Superbench Figure Tool workspace. No third-party illustration, proprietary library artwork, tracing, or embedded raster material was used.

The workspace owner authorized the redesign of these three existing nucleic-acid assets and previously allowed unrestricted reuse of the original Figure Tool assets. These original redraws continue the owner-selected CC0-1.0 dedication.
